slice: PR-path rollback observation for WF09 record_rollback_local
author: Claude Code (Opus 5.5)

decision.user_choice: option 1 (recommended): judge rollback from cluster facts; GitHub main == rollback revision recorded as handoff information, never a gate
decision.reason: RollbackScope.revision is fixed at approval (an existing, likely baseline, commit) while the WF07 sync check requires main head == deployed SHA, which would make every baseline-pinned rollback unverifiable

changes.restart_effects: observer accepts PR receipts with argo_application; per tick reads the Argo Application (fixed GET route); app UID change stops the run; argo_state healthy only if targetRevision, sync revision and last successful operation name the same 40-hex commit, health Healthy, not deleting
changes.rollback_observe: RollbackAppliedReader.applied (mode kubernetes): receipt only if same app, pinned+synced+succeeded+Healthy on scope revision, manual sync, same Deployment with generation observed, single api container running IMAGE_REPOSITORY@scope digest; applied_at = operation finishedAt (future rejected); source_hash from stable facts so re-reads match the sealed execution hash. alignment: gitops_main_matches True/False/None via existing _main_sha for allowed repositories only. RollbackObservationReader (mode sealed_capture) pairs it with the A7-4 sealed reader
changes.recovery_effects: record_rollback_local stores reader.alignment result as rollback_note (informational, never a gate, cleared on prune); result_text adds one line only when present; judgement rules unchanged

mutations: scope revision comparison removed (detected after adding a consistently-other-revision case)

test_data_note: two initial failures were test-data issues (the 'changed' application UID equalled the fixture UID; a degraded-at-record expectation) and were corrected, not product defects

other_checks.resource_warning_as_error: passed (rollback, restart effects, recovery effects tests)

not_in_scope: rollback execution path (baseline pin vs revert PR) and its approval/lock/revalidation
process wiring and authenticated RollbackScope reader
GitHub read identity and real Argo application name
no_external_actions: no cluster, GitHub, deploy, Slack, incident drill, Terraform, paid model call
